title: Almost all graphs are determined by their generalized spectrum
summary: A complete Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the theorem that almost all graphs are determined by their generalized spectrum, which is Haemers' conjecture for the generalized spectrum. The generalized spectrum of a graph is the spectrum of its adjacency matrix A together with the spectrum of the adjacency matrix J - I - A of its complement, and a graph is determined by its generalized spectrum (DGS) if every graph with the same generalized spectrum is isomorphic to it.
